bib.title: MemLong: Memory-Augmented Retrieval for Long Text Modeling

question: Can an explicit external retriever over a frozen-lower-layer memory bank of chunk-level K-V pairs extend a decoder-only LLM's usable context cheaply, without the distribution shift of earlier memory models?
hypothesis: Explicit chunk retrieval can approximate the implicit retrieval inside the model, and caching K-V from frozen lower layers keeps the cached distribution consistent.
contributions: Ret-mem module: non-differentiable retriever plus memory of chunk K-V pairs and embeddings, with a frequency-counter dynamic update
Retrieval causal attention in upper layers with a LLaMA-adapter style gate
Experiments on long-context language modeling and retrieval-augmented in-context learning, extending context to 80k on one 3090

method.summary: OpenLLaMA-3B is split into frozen lower layers and trainable upper layers (LoRA). After memory layer 13, each text chunk is embedded by a frozen dense retriever and its K-V pairs are cached. Top-k chunks by cosine similarity are retrieved and their K-V pairs are fused with local context in upper retrieval layers via retrieval causal attention.
method.task: long-context language modeling and retrieval-augmented in-context learning

datasets.name: SlimPajama (as sampled by Fu et al., 2024)
PG-19
datasets.preprocessing: perplexity on last 2048 tokens of each sequence, lengths 1k to 32k

datasets.name: SST-2, MR, Subj, SST-5, MPQA
datasets.preprocessing: 4-shot and 20-shot ICL; demonstrations held in memory

models.name: MemLong-3B
models.architecture: decoder-only, OpenLLaMA-3B with ret-mem module and retrieval causal attention
models.context: local context up to 2048 tokens; memory sizes 4K/32K evaluated, up to 80k claimed

other.head_dim: inferred: paper prints d = 100 in 'L = 26, H = 32, d = 100'
other.retriever: frozen FlagEmbedding (Xiao et al. 2023b; Zhang et al. 2023a), exact-search faiss index on GPU

training.objective: next-token prediction with retrieval, p(x_i | R(t_i), x_<i)

other.position_remapping: local context up to 2048 tokens gets standard rotary encoding; memory keys encoded as if at position 0
other.gate: zero-init style gate g_l following LLaMA-adapter

inference.prompting: ICL: 4-shot and 20-shot; additional demonstrations stored in memory (In-Memory #Demons 4 or 18)
inference.retrieval: cosine similarity of chunk embedding to stored embeddings, top-k chunks, k not stated; K-V of chunk indices retrieved from memory layer

parameters.dynamic_memory_update: on overflow keep latest 10%, drop oldest 10%, prune middle 80% by retrieval frequency until memory usage is 50%

metrics.name: Perplexity
metrics.definition: on last 2048 tokens of each sequence, following Yen et al. 2024

eval.protocol: single run, no seeds or significance reported; all perplexity runs on one 3090 24GB GPU

results.claim: MemLong gains up to 10.2 percentage points over OpenLLaMA in retrieval-augmented ICL (abstract of intro).
results.setup: ICL on 5 NLU tasks, OpenLLaMA-3B comparison
results.quote: MemLong achieves an improvement of up to 10.2 percentage points over OpenLLaMA.
results.note: Conclusion says 10.4 points versus the full-context model. Table 2 Subj 20-shot is 65.8 vs 55.4, which is 10.4; no cell gives 10.2.

results.claim: On 20-shot ICL with 18 in-memory demonstrations MemLong averages 73.4 vs OpenLLaMA 69.0 and LongLLaMA 72.7.
results.setup: 20 in-context + 18 in-memory demos, SST-2 MR Subj SST-5 MPQA, OpenLLaMA-3B base
results.note: OpenLLaMA 20-shot avg 69.0; LongLLaMA 72.7; OpenLLaMA w/ Rag 71.3

results.claim: At 4 in-context demos with 18 in-memory demos MemLong averages 71.0 vs OpenLLaMA 68.9.
MemLong keeps lowering perplexity past the 2048 pretrained length where OpenLLaMA-3B explodes (>10^3 at 4k); with 32K memory PG19 PPL at 16k is 9.73.
results.setup: OpenLLaMA-3B backbone, w/ 32K Memory, perplexity on last 2048 tokens, one 3090 24GB
results.table: Table 1, row w/ 32K Memory, PG19 column 16k
results.note: w/ 4K Memory gives 9.64 at 16k, lower than 32K memory on PG19; 32K memory is better on BookCorpus and Wikitext-103 at 4k

results.claim: On PG19 at 4k, MemLong with 32K memory has PPL 9.83 vs LongLLaMA-3B with infinite memory 9.87 and Phi3-128k 9.66.
results.table: Table 1, row w/ 32K Memory, PG19 column 4k
results.note: Phi3-128k is lower (9.66), so MemLong is not best on PG19 at 4k

results.claim: Training cost: 3B MemLong fine-tuned on 0.5B tokens with eight 3090s for eight hours.
results.quote: finetuning a 3B parameter version of MemLong on 0.5B tokens requires only eight 3090 GPUs for eight hours

results.claim: Context extended on a single 3090 GPU from 4k to 80k.
results.note: Abstract says 4k to 80k; conclusion says 2k to 80k. The 80k figure is not tested in a table; Table 1 goes to 16k (text mentions up to 32768).

results.claim: Trainable parameters and fine-tune data are lower than LongLLaMA.
Retrieval in every upper layer hurts; sparser retrieval layers [14,18,22,26] with frozen half is best (PG19 2k PPL 9.85 vs 11.43 for RA+TA).
results.table: Table 3, row w. RLP + TH, column PG19 2k
results.note: Text says best layers are [13,17,21,25] while Section 4.1 says [14,18,22,26] for the retrieval layers; likely a 0-index difference

results.claim: A memory size of 65536 is a threshold beyond which performance jumps (read from Fig 5, not tabulated).
results.note: Text: a critical threshold is identified at a memory size of 65536

limits: Only OpenLLaMA-3B tested; other sizes left to future work (Limitations)
Single-layer K-V pairs give additional semantic information but it is unstable (Limitations)
Fixed FlagEmbedding retriever only; no retriever ablation
No optimizer, LR, batch size, chunk size, top-k, LoRA rank, seeds reported
80k context claim is not backed by a results table; no downstream long-document tasks (QA, summarisation) evaluated
Perplexity is the main metric; ICL tasks are classification sentiment-style tasks
Compared models differ in fine-tuning data (5B vs 0.5B)

terms.definition: module of a Retriever and a Memory component for information exchange, memory holding K-V pairs and representation embeddings
the final layer of the frozen lower layers, whose K-V pairs are cached

lineage.note: Memory bank; MemLong avoids its distribution shift by freezing lower layers
Also stores K-V; position remapping follows it
